name: Colonial Heights city, VA
findings: Colonial Heights city has 69 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Colonial Heights city has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Colonial Heights city list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
